title: Izina ryahawe mbere y'uko avuka
intro: Tekereza ahantu hatuje huzuye ubusabe bukomeye nyuma y'imyaka myinshi yo gutegereza. Mu bitagaragara haza igisubizo gifite izina ritigeze ritangwa mbere, gisezeranya ubwenge bwo mu bwana n'ubuzima burangwa n'ubwitange, impuhwe n'ubuziranenge.
clues: Nahawe izina na Allah ubwe mbere yuko mvuka, izina ritigeze rihabwa undi muntu uwo ari we wese mbere yanjye.
Nahawe nk'igisubizo cy'amasengesho y'ababyeyi bageze mu za bukuru batekerezaga ko abana badashobora kubaho.
Nahawe ubwenge, ubwenge, n'Ibyanditswe Byera nkiri muto.
Nari inyangamugayo ku babyeyi banjye kandi nkagira impuhwe ku bandi, kandi sinari umwibone cyangwa ngo mbe umugome.
Imana yantegetse amahoro ku munsi navukiyeho, umunsi nzapfa, n'umunsi nzazurwa ndi muzima.
Data Zakariya yakiriye inkuru nziza yanjye ayibwiwe n'abamarayika ubwo yari ahagaze mu isengesho mu rusengero (mihrab).

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
